title: Unblock integration for ALPHA-TEMPLATE-EVALUATION-20261110: exact-head-merge-conflict

root_cause.summary: PR #7144 head conflicts with dev in services/research/main.py and services/research/tests/test_alpha_template_evaluation.py (add/add).
root_cause.cause: Earlier repair PR #7147 (CI-RED unblock, commit 433b21a13) already carried the full alpha template evaluation into dev, with two required fixes: lazy import of run_alpha_template_evaluation in main.py and an autouse REGISTRY_STORE_BACKEND=memory fixture in the test file. The original #7144 branch was left behind with the pre-fix versions of those files, so merging it conflicts with, and would regress, dev.
root_cause.files_differing: main.py and test_alpha_template_evaluation.py differ only by dev already having the #7147 fixes; no feature content from #7144 is missing from dev.

resolution: No code merge needed. #7144 is superseded by #7147 and should be closed rather than integrated; this repair branch records the evidence.

verification.merge_tree: git merge-tree HEAD origin/task/ALPHA-TEMPLATE-EVALUATION-20261110 reproduces the 2-file conflict
verification.diff_check: git diff origin/dev origin/task/ALPHA-TEMPLATE-EVALUATION-20261110 shows evaluator, registry, requirements identical; only the #7147 fixes differ
